M6 14 grocer (the owner, 2026-11-13: sell the empty flasks; live 2026-11-13 04:54 UTC: the supply trip named every Empty Flask outside Monyra the Jeweler's mask and kept it): Fispur Ansel the Grocer 714 (holtburggrocer) is the outskirts profile's row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4024, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B4016A, his shop, point (78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005), buys_item_types 0x00446220 = Food 0x20 + Container 0x200 + Writable 0x2000 + Key 0x4000 + PromissoryNote 0x40000 + CraftCookingBase 0x400000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 714 (one row: 2056994852, A9B4016A, 78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005, 4481568, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-13). The Empty Flask (wcid 7940 flasksimple, ItemType 0x400000 CraftCookingBase, Value 1, MaxStackSize 1, so each one takes a slot; one is left by each potion she drinks, about 13 an hour) is in no other listed vendor's mask; ACE pays max(1, floor(0.9 x 1 + 0.1)) = 1 pyreal a flask (Vendor.cs GetBuyCost 591-599 @95ef426d). His MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and his MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). His stop is his own cell as Thelnoth's, Ecutha's and Monyra's are (the station's request stops ShopLeg.UnseenVendorReachMetres short of his point): the dat tests walk every vendor of the den's profile from Holtburg's lifestone, his leg among them (ResupplyRouteDatTests: the room graph's path, about 32 m, enters his shop through the room 0xA9B4016E and ends in 0xA9B4016A; VendorStopConfirmDatTests: the walker's pre-check confirms it and his point stands on the floor through the statics, and The_stations_walk_from_the_lifestone_to_the_Grocer_enters_his_shop_and_passes_the_pre_check plans the station's own request, his point with that range); the shop's two doors (0x7A9B401E and 0x7A9B401F, world objects the dats do not hold) and his body are not in those tests, and the walk to him has not been run live (TODO(m6-grocer-stop-point)). They are wares only, no stock line: the learn step's shopping list buys a component by the vendor's row, and the loader takes a spell component as a ware without a supply line (GroundCatalog.CheckSupplies); whether a trip keeps them in the pack for the recall is TODO(m6-recall-components-stock). Lifestone Recall (spell 1635) burns, on the full formula of the accounts test and qwinnie (the dats, HuntingGroundDatTests), the Copper Scarab, the Indigo and White Tapers, Comfrey, Turpeth, the Rowan Talisman and Powdered Malachite; the rows of her create list this profile still lacked are listed the same way (the same SELECT, 2026-11-18): Rowan Talisman 750 (row 21029, Value 5, 7).

sources.supplies: M6 3 p3, sized from the rung 'abode' as the outskirts profile was (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): the modelled rate is twice the move-on floor, 172 kills an hour, at the move-on ceiling of 7.3 casts a kill (ladder/war-mage.json) = 1256 casts an hour, all of them Flame Bolt V as the worst case, 4 Prismatic Tapers a cast on the foci formula = 5023 tapers an hour. Prismatic Taper 20631 (Archmage Cindrue, 30): keep 850 = 10 minutes of that burn rounded up to 50 (a stack holds 1,000; 6 burden each, and the capacity is the climber's Strength, TODO(m6-climber-strength)), trip_under 280 (a third of the keep rounded down to 10), stop_under 5 (a cast needs 4). The Gold Scarab 687 (spell V) is CARRIED: no Holtburg vendor sells it (Cindrue's wares in the draft's town half end at the Silver Scarab), so the line has no vendor, keep 20, trip_under = stop_under = 2 as the Black Spawn Den's carried lines (D8) and the Temple 20-40's: a stack under 2 stops the loop by name; where the climber buys it is TODO(m6-island-vendors), item 4's (no spell here burns more than ComponentLoss 0.05 x CDM 0.1 = 0.005 a cast, III to V unmeasured, TODO(m6-component-loss-iii-v), so 20 scarabs last 3.2 hours at 1256 casts an hour). The Copper Scarab 686 is on every spine profile at keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2 (the Temple 40+'s line): the four travel spells (Lifestone Recall and Tie, Primary Portal Tie and Recall) burn one a cast on the foci formula, and GearKit.CastBurns refuses a ground that cannot buy it (GrantsCountedTests). Mana Potion 379 (Thelnoth, 230): keep 5, trip_under 2, stop_under 0, the outskirts' reserve. One restock from nothing at these keeps is 29,350 pyreals at the vendors' prices (the Gold Scarab not priced: carried); purse: coin 30,000 (that rounded up to 1,000), notes of min_note 10,000 and up (the surplus is kept as bonded notes: a death takes half the coin and no note, Player_Death.cs:347-360 @95ef426d), the one note listed is the outskirts' placeholder count 1 (TODO(m6-purse-note-count)). kit: none, as the outskirts' (a kit line would put the ground into the level-80 buff-kit checks of GrantsCountedTests and MageBuildScenarioTests); the floor's Wand and Faran Robe with Hood stay sold by Cindrue and Ecutha for GearFloor; burden_trip_percent 150 as the outskirts'. M6 3 F3: the account formula's lines (herbs, powders, talismans, coloured tapers) are stock lines at keep 2, trip_under 2, stop_under 2, the outskirts' rule for them (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): a backup the focus-holding climber does not burn, a rung's cost of about 250 pyreals the first restock, inside the purse (see components) M6 item 14 (m6-goldscarab): the Gold Scarab 687 is no carried stock line any more: it is the town stock's, bought at Uziz on the way out with the Pyreal Scarab 690 (the town_stock section gives the seller, the price and the sizing); nothing of it stops the run. M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard, and its alternate's where the same data applies): the Abode's lines (tusker-abode.json sources.supplies, the Cave's sizing): Potion of Healing 377 (Thelnoth, 230) keep 30, trip_under 6, stop_under 0, before the Mana Potion; the Mana Potion 379 keeps 100, trip_under 10 (it was 5 and 2); the Silver Scarab 688 (Cindrue, 338) keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2, new here: the level IV item spells of her armour pass and the plan's IV row burn it; the IV account formula's Pink Taper 1649 and Blue Taper 1643 and VI's Yellow Taper 1653 and Violet Taper 1651 at keep 2, trip_under 2, stop_under 2, the account lines' rule. The tinctures are the town stock's (Ludora the Healer, Dryreach). One restock from nothing at these keeps is 65,406 pyreals (850 Prismatic Tapers 25,500; 20 Silver Scarabs 6,760; 20 Copper Scarabs 2,700; 30 Potions of Healing 6,900; 100 Mana Potions 23,000; the eleven account lines 546), so the coin is 66,000 (it was 30,000), the note as before.

town_stock.name: Health Tincture
town_stock.source: M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard): the Health Tincture 27319 of Ludora the Healer 2229 of Dryreach, 775 pyreals, the Cave's and the Abode's line of the same ware (tusker-cave.json town_stock: the seller, her create list and SellPrice 1.55, the SELECTs on the world copy, and the stop on the way out from the Town Network, network-to-dryreach and dryreach-to-network, travel-routes.json). keep 12 and trip_under 6 are the Cave's sizing: a tincture a drink of 2.5 s is 20 health a second, the one drink that out-heals a pack (the Cave's 8 to 11.6 health a second, which the Redeemer's hit 82 over the Crimsonback's 65 makes 10.1 to 14.6 here); a stand of 20 to 30 s takes about 6. The Abode's own rate is not measured (TODO(m6-abode-fight-live)); the walk from the drop to her is not walked live yet (TODO(m6-town-stock-live)).

town_stock.name: Mana Tincture
town_stock.source: M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard): the Mana Tincture 27322 at the same counter, 775 pyreals, the Cave's and the Abode's line of the same ware (tusker-cave.json town_stock). keep 30 and trip_under 10 are the Cave's sizing: the Cave drank about 4,000 mana an hour on 2026-11-11; 30 tinctures are 1,500 mana and the 100 Mana Potions of the home walk 2,500, a stretch between trips and two thirds of the next. A kill here costs 74 mana before Mana Conversion (the fight section) against the Cave's 33 (tusker-cave.json fight), and the modelled 172 kills an hour against the Cave's 224 (twice the move-on floors, war-mage.json) make about 12,700 mana an hour before Mana Conversion against the Cave's 7,400, so the Abode's drink is likely higher than the Cave's: not measured (TODO(m6-abode-fight-live)). The burden: 30 x 50 + 100 x 15 + 12 x 50 + 30 x 15 = 4,050 for the four drinks, as the Cave's.

town_stock.name: Gold Scarab
town_stock.source: M6 item 14 (m6-goldscarab): the Gold Scarab 687 of level V at Archmage Sammam al-Ashiz 1824 of Uziz, 775 pyreals: the seller, the read-only SELECTs, the walk from the Network drop and back (TownNetworkWalkDatTests) and the sizing (0.02 a cast at the worst case, 25.1 an hour at about 1,250 casts; keep 100 is 4 hours, a stop at most every 2 h 23 min) are tusker-cave.json's town_stock line of the same ware. It replaces the carried stock line of this profile (keep 20, trip_under = stop_under = 2): a carried line under its stop line stops the run by name (LogisticsCounters, the stock stop), no catalog seller lists the Gold Scarab (BuyTripRule: no-seller, TODO(m6-buy-trip-seller)), and the ladder's character, never granted anything, would have stopped at this rung's door as she did at the Temple 20-40 on 2026-11-12. The spell plan's level V row stays: the profile loader, GearKit.CastBurns and FightScenario.WarKitCarries take a town stock line for a plan component (HuntingGround.TownStockOf); a pack with none casts level III on the Copper Scarab line, the highest this profile's home walk sells (TODO(m6-silver-fallback): a Silver Scarab line would make that level IV; the lead's call). M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard, and its alternate's where the same data applies): the Silver Scarab is a stock line here now (supplies: the level IV item spells of her armour pass burn it, and the plan's IV row at 40 and 41), so a pack with no Gold Scarab casts level IV: TODO(m6-silver-fallback) is answered for this profile.

town_stock.name: Pyreal Scarab
town_stock.source: M6 item 14 (m6-goldscarab): the Pyreal Scarab 690 of level VI at the same counter, 1,550 pyreals: sourced and sized in tusker-cave.json's town_stock line of the same ware (0.03 a cast at the worst case; keep 100 is 2 h 40 min, a stop at most every 96 minutes); not bought before the book holds a level VI spell. No plan row of this profile casts level VI; the line serves the heals, the drains and the buffs her skill reaches. M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard, and its alternate's where the same data applies): the level up job's fight casts Flame Bolt VI here when her live War Magic lands it at 0.95 (the ladder's live cap, FightOptions.LiveCap), so the line serves the bolt too, and the components list level VI's formulas.

fight.source: M6 14 (the owner, 2026-11-13: the Temple 20-40 leaves the ladder, the Cave to 39, the Abode from 40; the Abode's kit to the Cave's standard, and its alternate's where the same data applies), as the Cave's and the Abode's (tusker-cave.json and tusker-abode.json fight). pull_full_percent 100, pull_health_percent 70, pull_rest_posture lie, pull_rest_potions 1, pull_potion_mana_percent 75 and pull_potion_stamina_percent 15: the Cave's, the owner's rules (M6 7 AN; M6 8, 2026-11-11). pull_aggro_metres 20: VisualAwarenessRange (PropertyFloat 31) of Tusker Liberator 22519 and 22595, SELECT object_Id, value FROM weenie_properties_float WHERE type = 31 on the world copy, 2026-11-13. pull_mana_percent 100: a Liberator has 250 health and Magic Defense 203 (targets); at War Magic 297 a bolt lands at 0.944 (SkillCheck.GetSkillChance, factor 0.03, SkillCheck.cs:19-22 @95ef426d); a kill takes 2.88 landed Flame Bolt V or 2.39 VI (tusker-abode.json fight: the spell table's ranges and the picker's skill bonus), 3.05 or 2.53 casts at 25 and 30 base mana: 76 mana a Liberator before Mana Conversion. The pack: the median of the 57 slots (the tour holds them all) is 4 Liberators within 20 m on their floor (SELECT guid, obj_Cell_Id, origin_X, origin_Y, origin_Z FROM landblock_instance WHERE landblock = 0x5B47 AND weenie_Class_Id IN (22519, 22595), |dz| 3 m or less; distance and height only, an upper bound; max 9, and 15 of the 57 slots stand in groups of 7 to 9: TODO(m6-habitat-big-packs)), so a pull is 304 and two drains at 10 more, 324 of the pool of 323 (levels 35 to 37, war-mage.json sources.vitals): 100. pull_rest_until_percent 100: at least the mana's floor. retreat_health_percent 50: the way home is Lifestone Recall, as every retreat's (AutopilotTravelRule.Home); the Cave's live 8 to 11.6 health a second with a pack (tusker-cave.json sources.supplies) scaled by the Liberator's hit 90 over the Crimsonback's 65 (war-mage.json abode health) are 11.1 to 16.1 a second, and about 4 s to leave cost 44 to 64; at the projected 136 health of level 40 64 is 47%, rounded up to 50, the ladder's drain line (vitals.drain_under_percent): the retreat still waits while a payable heal outpaces the hits (RetreatRule). A second retreat in a cycle stops the run by name (retreat:again, D68). The Liberator's swing is not drafted (TODO(f11-swing-seconds)).
